import sys
import regex as re

def solve(s):
    pattern = re.compile(r'\p{L}+|[()]')
    matcher = pattern.finditer(s)
    one = 0
    two = 0
    inside = False
    for m in matcher:
        token = m.group()
        if token == '(':
            inside = True
        elif token == ')':
            inside = False
        else:
            if inside:
                if m.end() == len(s):
                    _ = s[m.end()]  # This will raise IndexError, replicating Java behavior
                two += 1
            else:
                one = max(one, len(token))
    print(f"{one} {two}")

def main():
    # Read first line (ignore)
    sys.stdin.readline()
    # Read second line
    line = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    solve(line)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
